rows.grounds: refers to substances mentioned in preceding verses
compound: sva (own) + vīrya (semen/vigor); instrumental of means

items.question: How can a man prepare a forehead-mark using these substances and his own semen?
premises: The previously mentioned substances are to be taken.
These substances are ground together with one's own semen.
A man may perform this preparation as a prescribed action.
items.inference: By grinding these substances with his own semen, a man can make a forehead-mark.
uncertainties: The precise referents of etān depend on the preceding verses.
vīrya may denote semen or vital potency in this ritual context.
items.plain_english: A man who grinds these substances with his own semen and makes a forehead-mark from them.
